scope: Content interpretation, colour, functions, forms, optional content and page transforms checked against the local ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text. Implemented transparency in clause 11, analytic shadings and shading patterns in 8.7, annotation appearances in 12.5 and continuous-tone halftone bypass in 10.6 are covered by independent fixtures. Exact-area bytes, Bradford adaptation, sRGB output and rounding are project policy. ICC tag processing awaits primary ICC-text review.

requirements.gaps: text, images and general stroke adjustment remain incomplete
requirements.rule: Graphics-state changes, construction, painting and clipping follow Tables 51, 52 and 58 through 60; the current path is separate from saved graphics state.
Operands immediately precede their operator, contain no indirect references, and may span Contents-array elements between lexical tokens.

requirements.status: all 73 Annex A operators recognized with positioned operand and path-state validation
requirements.gaps: text, images and Type3; mesh shadings and tiling patterns; legacy image.inline tag retained
requirements.rule: Annex A lists content operators; their defining tables govern operands, while Table 33 permits unknown operators only inside compatibility sections.

requirements.status: device, Indexed, CalGray/CalRGB/Lab, tint alternates and source ICC matrix/TRC
requirements.gaps: ICC LUTs, nondefault ICC ranges, special colourants and nonzero calibrated BlackPoint
requirements.rule: Device conversion, default remapping, Indexed lookup, tint alternates and colour selection follow their source-space rules; ICC profile handling is constrained by Tables 65 and 66.

requirements.status: opaque Normal RGB fast path; general composition covered by content-transparency
requirements.gaps: calibrated blending spaces, subtractive overprint and transfer-region selection
requirements.rule: Opaque Normal non-knockout RGB composition is associative under 11.3 and 11.4; remaining groups retain their isolated backdrop, shape, alpha and colour-space semantics.
CropBox bounds visible user space, Rotate acts clockwise in multiples of 90 degrees, and UserUnit scales both axes in multiples of 1/72 inch; see Table 31.
Fractional coordinates retain their geometric meaning through stroking, filling and clipping; exact overlap integration and rounding are project policies.
Form invocation saves state, concatenates Matrix, clips to BBox, executes with applicable resources and restores state; Table 93 also specifies optional-content skipping.

requirements.status: default configuration, membership expressions and View usage applications
requirements.rule: Membership policies and expressions combine applicable groups, intent controls applicability, and configuration and nesting control visibility; see Tables 97 through 99.

requirements.status: CalGray, CalRGB and Lab; Bradford white adaptation to D65, sRGB output
requirements.rule: CalGray, CalRGB and Lab use the component ranges and XYZ equations of Tables 62 through 64. Bradford white adaptation, relative-colorimetric fallback, sRGB output and rounding are project device policy.

requirements.status: sampled, exponential, stitching, calculator; tint alternates and transfer functions
requirements.gaps: sampled cubic interpolation with size >=4; special None/All colourants; transfer-region selection under transparency
requirements.rule: Functions clip inputs and outputs to declared bounds and follow their type-specific definitions; transfer functions operate after conversion to the output device space.

requirements.status: View applications; View/Print/Export recommendations, initial Zoom=1; AND across AS entries
requirements.gaps: user/language/creator-specific categories require explicit viewer context
requirements.rule: Usage applications combine recommendations across applicable categories and entries; Zoom includes its minimum and excludes its maximum; see Tables 100 and 101.

requirements.status: normal appearance streams, screen visibility and state selection
constant opacity, standard blend modes, isolated/non-isolated and knockout groups, Gray/RGB/CMYK
requirements.gaps: calibrated group blending; subtractive overprint; transfer-region selection

requirements.status: Alpha/Luminosity, BC and TR with frozen source CTM
function, axial and radial shadings; shading patterns; global device-centre sampling and optional box filtering
requirements.gaps: mesh shadings, tiling patterns, pattern ExtGState; degenerate BBox scan conversion

requirements.rule: Supported embedded source profiles are processed rather than replaced by Alternate. ICCBased source components initialize to zero; only later unsupported profile versions use an alternate. ICC v2.0–2.4 and v4.0–4.3 Gray/RGB matrix/TRC tag definitions, including parametric and sampled curves, are implemented with independent formula oracles pending primary ICC-text review. Bradford PCS-D50 adaptation, relative-colorimetric fallback and sRGB output are project policy.
requirements.status: source matrix/TRC processing; tag definitions pending primary ICC-text review
requirements.gaps: LUT profiles; calibrated group inverse transforms; nondefault ranges; primary ICC specification not locally available
